#WxHistory |
[🧵; 2feat.] #OTDwx: Typhoon Yagi ‘24 (Enteng) became the most significant typhoon of the year. Yagi was a very powerful typhoon in the South China Sea. At 165mph / 907mb, it’s the strongest typhoon in the SCS on record.

Yagi brought major flooding to the Philippines as it brushed by there. It then went to Hainan & directly went over the city of Haikou. It brought destructive wind gust well over 130mph (210kph). Yagi became the 2nd costliest typhoon in China’s history.

Then Yagi slammed Vietnam, hitting as a high end C3, the strongest in the country’s history. Areas in N 🇻🇳, mainly around Hanoi was railed. Extreme storm surge, winds & flooding messed up much of that area. It became the country’s costliest disaster ever. Thailand & Myanmar faced a very high death toll from flooding.

Overall, Yagi killed anywhere between 844 & 1,138. It dealt $14.7B in damages. Thankfully Yagi (and Enteng; Edring was its replacement) were retired. 
[1/2]
